speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are experiencing generalized fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver function tests; let's start by asking if you have noticed any yellowing of your skin or the whites of your eyes?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old male. The patient reports a 2-month history of increasing generalized fatigue and severe pruritus. He has known hypertension and was diagnosed with ulcerative colitis 5 years ago. He mentions being sexually active with 2 female partners and inconsistent condom use.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis (PBC).
Your history of fatigue, severe itching, and abnormal liver tests, combined with the specific mention of ulcerative colitis, is highly suggestive of an autoimmune condition like PBC. Did you notice any pale stools or dark urine recently?
